data.narrative:
Recursion Pharmaceuticals is a public-stage biotech company in the Biotech & Health sector, currently valued at $1.6B following $2B+ in total raised capital. The valuation assessment is grounded in a peer universe of 5 companies spanning similar valuation tiers and sector positioning, including both private (Chai Discovery at $3.8B, New Limit at $3.1B, Eikon Therapeutics at $539M) and public comparables (Freenome at $1.1B, Alto Neuroscience at $1.0B).

The peer-median triangulation method is applicable and yields an implied valuation of $1.1B, based on the median across the five-company cohort. The peer range spans $539M to $3.8B, reflecting variance in stage maturity and capital efficiency. Public-comp anchoring using sector price-to-sales multiples (9.2x median across 3 Biotech & Health tickers: RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) cannot be applied due to absence of disclosed revenue for Recursion in the dataset.

The single-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $935M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median of $1.1B. Recursion's current $1.6B valuation sits materially above this peer-median range. Key uncertainties include pipeline maturity, revenue run-rate visibility, and whether the target's platform differentiation justifies a premium to the measured peer cohort. Further analysis would require disclosed financials or revenue guidance to validate sector multiples.
